scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core -w packages/server -w packages/cli -w packages/ui --if-present
scripts.dev: npm run dev -w packages/cli & npm run dev -w packages/ui & wait
scripts.test:e2e:docker: docker compose -f test/e2e/docker-compose.yml up --build -d --wait && E2E_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:18081 playwright test -c test/e2e/playwright.config.ts; EXIT=$?; docker compose -f test/e2e/docker-compose.yml down -v; exit $EXIT
